bio.text: Julie Fedorchak is a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from North Dakota.
She previously spent 12 years on the North Dakota Public Service Commission and was president of the National Association of Regulatory Utility Commissioners, a post she completed in November 2024.
Earlier she was state director for U.S. Senator John Hoeven and communications director for Governor Ed Schafer, and she ran her own communications business for 10 years.
She was born in Williston, was raised in Fargo, graduated from the University of North Dakota, and lives in Mandan.
